Eternity

Robert Herrick (1591–1674)

O Y
EARS!
 and Age! farewell:
Behold I go
Where I do know
Infinity to dwell.
And these mine eyes shall see
All times, how they
Are lost i’ th’ sea
Of vast Eternity.
Where never Moon shall sway
The stars; but she
And Night, shall be
Drown’d in one endless Day.
